bleeding.label: Bleeding
bleeding.description: At turn start −1 Wounds per level; 10% chance per level to fall unconscious

stunned.label: Stunned
stunned.description: No action; −10 to tests per level

ablaze.label: Ablaze
ablaze.description: At turn start d10 + level − 1 damage

entangled.label: Entangled
entangled.description: Cannot move; −10 to tests per level

prone.label: Prone
prone.description: Cannot move; melee attacks against it get +20

surprised.label: Surprised
surprised.description: No action; attacks against it get +20

blinded.label: Blinded
blinded.description: −20 to own attacks; attacks against it get +20

log.unconscious: 💤 {name} drops to 0 Wounds and falls unconscious

head.1: The blow only rings through the skull.
head.2: A split brow floods the eyes with blood.
head.4: The helm cracks and the foe sways like a drunkard.
head.5: The skull caves in, and consciousness gutters like a candle.

arm.1: The arm bones ache from the strike.
arm.2: A deep cut, blood seeping through the sleeve.
arm.3: Fingers spasm open and the weapon drops.
arm.4: An artery is opened, blood spurts forth.
arm.5: The arm hangs limp, the weapon slips away.

body.2: Breath is knocked out, wheezing and coughing.
body.3: A ragged wound in the flank, the blood will not stop.
body.4: The blade bites deep, guts afire.
body.5: A chest blow topples the foe, darkness closing in.

leg.1: The knee buckles for a moment.
leg.2: A shin wound leaves a trail of blood.
leg.3: Legs swept, the foe sprawls in the mud.
leg.4: Tendon severed, the foe falls screaming.
leg.5: The knee is shattered, no more walking.
